lines.text: Josiah commanded the people to keep the Passover, and none like it had been observed since the judges.
Josiah removed the mediums, spiritists, household gods and idols to carry out the words of the law Hilkiah found.
There was no king like Josiah, who turned to the LORD according to all the Law of Solomon.
The LORD stayed angry at Judah because of what Amon had done, and He would remove Judah from His sight.
Pharaoh Neco killed Josiah at Megiddo, and his servants brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his tomb.
